notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Changelog
notes.content:
With this update we hope to fix the most common crash we saw, which is an out of VRAM error. We completely reworked the way how we store the ingame textures, reducing the overall size of the game by almost 2 GB and reducing the overall VRAM usage heavily as well. Also, most rendered objects now require about 30% less texture lookups, which may result in some performance gains depending on your system.

[hr][/hr]

 Repacked most of the ingame textures

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Changelog
notes.content:
Changed opponent paint job on European Forest 5 & American Desert 3
 Fixed SteamVR overlay making the game unresponsive in some cases
 Fixed bridges loading the wrong model
 Fixed controller switch track button not resetting when releasing controller
 Fixed cars not stopping when releasing controller at low throttle
 Fixed long black screen when launching the game
 Fixed several small internal issues

IMPORTANT: If you have a map uploaded to the workshop, this will not repair it, unfortunately. You'll need to reupload it for this to be fixed.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Changelog
notes.content: Fixed an issue introduced with 1.0.1 that caused the page buttons on the object table to not work

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Changelog
notes.content:
Added automatic crash reporting - this should help us identify and fix crashes and other bugs in the game
 Added race cancel button for campaign - this is currently campaign exclusive but will be ported to single- and multiplayer in the future
 Changed the controller power curve
 Fixed an issue that sometimes the main menu was more transparent than it should be
 Fixed some odd hitbox behavior

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MrDN2hygIiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Slotracers VR will release on March 4th for a price of $24.99 with a 10% launch discount. Regional pricing will apply, so the price may vary depending on your location.

Updated System Requirements
The system requirements previously stated on our storepage we're an estimate. However, the game has become much more demanding than we expected, so we needed to increase them. The new requirements are as follows:

Minimum
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or equivalent AMD Ryzen
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or equivalent AMD card (8 GB VRAM recommended)
DirectX: Version 11
Sound Card: Any sound card

Broadband internet connection recommended for online multiplayer.

Recommended
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Intel Core i5-7600k or equivalent AMD Ryzen
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080 or equivalent AMD card
DirectX: Version 11
Sound Card: Any sound card

Broadband internet connection recommended for online multiplayer.


Regarding Linux support
In the past we've advertised the game as having a native Linux version. Unfortunately, we need to cancel the version as a result of a recent engine upgrade where Linux support has been dropped by the engine. We've hoped that support would be added back quickly, however this didn't occur yet.

We've extensively tested the game with Proton and can confirm that the game is working perfectly fine with it. We'll look out for opportunities to restore the Linux version and will release it in the future if we can.

notes.title: Playtest Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

The playtest is now live! For those who haven't registered, registrations will remain open until December 24th at 7 P.M. CET.

Features
The playtest contains most of the game's features:

 Track editor with full set of tracks and scenery objects
 Race mode with all cars except campaign related cars
 Time of day settings
 Multiplayer


If you've played the Steam Game Festival demo last summer, your savefiles will most likely still load, however there may be bugs that wouldn't normally occur.

A note about car physics:
The car physics are not finished and will most likely change massively during and also after the playtest. If there are things you notice about it that are missing or just feel off, please tell us about it.

Linux
For those who wanted to play the playtest on Linux, we have some bad news for you. Since a recent engine upgrade we've done the Linux support for SteamVR is currently broken and therefore a native Linux build is currently not possible. However, we've tested the game with Proton and it works fine and currently we see this as a temporary solution for the problem.


We hope you'll be having fun during the playtest!

notes.title: Join the Slotracers VR Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

With us getting the game closer to how we'd like it to be, we're giving you the opportunity to help us test the game before we're releasing it to the wild!


How do I join?
You can join the playtest by navigating to our storepage and clicking the Request Access button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/a1da63b6878be8cb37f23d3cbfdac24e87b8f94f.png

Please note that we'll only allow a certain number of people at a time, so we can't guarantee that everyone will receive access.


When will the playtest start?
If everything goes to plan, the playtest will start on December 17th, 2020 at 7 PM CET. If this changes we'll let you know.


When will the playtest end?
This depends on how many issues arise. We currently anticipate ending the playtest on December 31st, 2020 at 7 PM CET, exactly 2 weeks later. However, we will lengthen the test if necessary.


What will be included?
As this playtest is supposed to test the entirety of the game, we'll include everything that's ready. Since we're still working on several things, we can't say exactly what'll be included. We'll share more details prior to the playtest.

It's possible however that more features will be added during the playtest.


Do I need to sign an NDA?
No. You can talk about it as much as you'd like, to whomever you like. Please remember however, if you'd like to for example make videos on YouTube, consider that the playtest is a non-final version and will most likely not be perfect. We'd like you to make this obvious.


How can I give feedback?
When given access to the playtest, you'll automatically receive access to the playtest's community hub. Any feedback should be given there.

Feedback is very important for us so feel free to give as much as you like. Bugs, suggestions, questions, everything is appreciated.

notes.title: State of Development #5
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Unfortunately, we'll not be sharing any new screenshots today, as there's not really anything relevant to show right now. More about that at the end of the devblog.

But because we still want to give you some new information, we'll share some info about the singleplayer campaign that is currently in development.

Environments

The campaign consists of 3 environments with 9 maps each, totalling at 21 maps.

European Countryside
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/5ef6f9b563a0ab15288d603d358dffe23ae34fe6.png

American Desert
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/75c192924390c95b6a47d7e66ffe2e51b5a2b17c.png

International Racecup
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/9de27ea4b2c2dc972622c08ffde710f2dd9832e2.png


Each campaign introduces new challenges, like an increased number of opponents and an increasingly difficult track layout.


Medals
For completing a race, you can get either a bronze, a silver or a gold medal, depending on your place.
After completing an environment with all medals of a certain type, you unlock the next one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/130bdcce66a3a8b447701d9f849c96d643280bce.jpg

Rewards
When completing the first environment, you'll unlock a special car. This car will get visual upgrades in the next environments.

The car is balanced to be similar to other cars to not give campaign players an unfair advantage.

Which car this will be will remain a secret for now.


Online Leaderboards
Every campaign map has an online leaderboard. Do your best, maybe you'll set a world record!
Races are also saved as a replay, allowing you to watch the records of other players.


Regarding the Release
We've stated in the past that we'd like to release in summer of 2020. We've already stated last devblog that this will not be possible (summer is over afterall).

The main reason the game is not out yet is because it was a lot more work than anticipated and there are a lot of things all over the place that still need to be done. The game is generally playable, but it's not the way we want it yet. Because we want to avoid releasing the game as an Early Access title, we'll be pushing it back as much as we need until we think it's ready for a full release.

We know that nobody likes to wait, but it's better in this case. This is also why we don't have a release date yet, it's just too hard to estimate the time we may need. The earliest is December, but depending on how it goes it might even slip into January 2021 or later.

We'll let you know when we know more.

Stay tuned and stay safe!

notes.title: Slotracers VR at the Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We've got some great news! Slotracers VR will be playable during the Steam Game Festival, coming June 16th. The game will be playable as a limited demo up until June 22nd.

[previewyoutube=w2JJOZD0qA0;full][/previewyoutube]


Important information

 The demo will be free for everyone. It will be removed from your library at the end of the event.
 The demo will not contain all cars. Only a small selection will be available.
 The demo will not have workshop support or achievements.
 The version available will be from our current beta version and will not be representative of the final product. Bugs are to be expected. (If you find any, please tell us!)



AMA
We'll be hosting an AMA in our community hub on June 16th at 7 PM CEST. The AMA will last for 2 hours. You may ask anything you want, questions about the game, the team, or anything else.

A thread for the AMA will be created by us when the event starts.


Delay
If you've seen this post before, you might have noticed that the date has changed. This is because Valve has decided to postpone the festival by a week.


We hope you'll be trying out the game when the event starts. Stay safe!

notes.title: State of Development #1
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

In this first entry of our probably not regularly posted blog about the state of development, we'd like to introduce you to a feature that we haven't yet shown to the public.

Multiple Maps
We added more maps to the game. Previously only the cellar, shown on our storepage, was available.

 Cellar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/88150b349eba6a2d98f5efae8db16ebbadccf266.png
The cellar is the map already shown on previous screenshots. A large rectangular room without much furniture, perfect for building a large racetrack.

 Attic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/1aca2ff7e44d15b6e2f4b2388139dbcc3e2341b8.png
The attic is a slightly smaller map. However, it does offer a lot of space and for most cases it's large enough.

 Bedroom
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/a6c661c9c264864f2c19cafaa91fb1a12c6385ab.png
The bedroom is a map targeted to those who'd like to build on the floor. Being the smallest of the 3 maps, it doesn't offer much space to build on tables. However, you can build nice tracks if you use the space efficiently.


Car Rework
We've been reworking some of the car models and textures as we felt that they weren't all on par with the newer cars. While we only have one example to show, we are currently working on several more cars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37046034/db95f92657ffc543da792a55779acead6cdd407f.jpg

Release Date
As a quick note about our release date, we still don't have a date to announce yet, but we are  confident that we'll be ready to launch in mid to late summer. As soon as we have an actual date to announce, we'll announce it in it's own post.


This wraps up our first state of development blog. Stay safe and we'll see you next time!
